newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian bond bull trend remains intact - traders.
newsitem.headline: Belgian bond bull trend remains intact - traders.

text.p: The bull trend in Belgian linear bonds remains solidly intact despite the emergence of some profit-taking by end-investors on Friday, traders said, after the market suffered a volatile day with Bunds.
"We have seen some selling by end-investors taking profits, but there is no fundamental change in the market's bull trend," one trader said.
"We have an exchange auction next week and a new auction the following week, so I see nothing imminent to change the mood or the direction," he added.
Traders said OLOs tracked German Bunds. Similarly to Thursday, market volume remained depressed with holders of paper reluctant to sell and incur a capital gains tax.
They said the only activity of any note had been in the shorter maturities.
The yield of the benchmark 2006 OLO, which on Thursday slipped below six percent for the first time, held at 5.98 percent, and the spread over Bunds remained at 16 basis points.
The December futures contract ended 13 basis points higher at 120.38. -- Jeremy Lovell, Brussels Newsroom +32 2 287 6810, Fax +32 2 230 7710
